trigger_condition.state_trigger: Model Parameter is assigned into an indexed/view-based tensor during a DDP-wrapped forward pass, leaving autograd state inconsistent for backward.
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: Forward pass under torch.nn.parallel.DistributedDataParallel followed by backward.
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: In a DDP-wrapped forward, assign a Parameter to an advanced-indexed view of an input tensor (e.g., x[[True, False]] = self.token), then perform backward.

bug_oracle.description: In a DDP-wrapped model's forward, assigning a Parameter to an advanced-indexed view of an input tensor and then performing backward triggers an autograd-related exception.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Generate forward graphs where model Parameters are assigned into indexed or view-based tensor positions that participate in backward.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Create leaf tensors requiring gradients and use advanced indexing or view operations to expose differentiable mutation paths.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Wrap the model or forward pass in DistributedDataParallel or an equivalent gradient-stateful wrapper before running backward.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Perform forward pass with parameter-involved indexed assignment, compute a loss, then run backward.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Treat any autograd exception, gradient state inconsistency, or deviation from eager reference semantics as a failure.
